Pairing made by me (Arnt 2010 vs Wilkinson 2014); Lundbeck's later rat papers cite LADDER but a citation is a pairing, not a stated comparison. safety.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
safety.confidence_note: No member of this class reached an NDA, so no nonclinical review exists; the toxicology species and findings for idalopirdine, masupirdine and SAM-760 are not public. Abstract-level reading.
safety.model: IND-enabling toxicology (species and findings unpublished; no NDA, so no FDA review)
safety.note: Idalopirdine caused asymptomatic transient transaminase rises in LADDER; whether animal toxicology predicted a hepatic signal is unpublished.
safety.quote: 25 patients (seven taking placebo and 18 taking idalopirdine) discontinued treatment because of adverse events, the difference between groups being mainly due to asymptomatic transient increases in transaminase concentrations in some idalopirdine-treated patients.
safety.judgement: Untested rather than an empty list: toxicology studies existed (INDs were opened for all three members) but nothing public compares them with patients. Phase 3 idalopirdine TEAEs were similar to placebo with Hy's-law monitoring (Atri 2018); SAM-760 (Fullerton 2018) and masupirdine (Nirogi 2022) were reported safe and well tolerated, so no patient harm exists to score a silence against.

safety.population: Mild-to-moderate AD dementia on stable donepezil (Phase 2, NCT01712074)
safety.model: IND-enabling toxicology (species and findings unpublished; no NDA, so no FDA review)
safety.note: SAM-760 was safe and well tolerated in AD patients; Pfizer published no toxicology, so no model prediction can be compared.
safety.quote: SAM-760 was safe and well tolerated, but there was no benefit of SAM-760 on measures of cognition, neuropsychiatric symptoms, or daily function.
safety.judgement: Split from safety 1: the same unpublished-toxicology system for SAM-760, whose patients had no harm signal unlike idalopirdine.

safety.population: Moderate AD dementia on donepezil + memantine (Phase 2, NCT02580305)
safety.model: IND-enabling toxicology (species and findings unpublished; no NDA, so no FDA review)
safety.note: Masupirdine was generally safe and well tolerated in AD patients; Suven published no toxicology margin, so no model prediction can be compared.
safety.quote: Masupirdine was generally safe and well tolerated.
safety.judgement: Split from safety 1: the same unpublished-toxicology system for masupirdine, whose patients had no harm signal unlike idalopirdine.
